# Handoff check · sounds

Recipes for your own synths. Nothing in this file is applied automatically.

## LEAD

trancegen preset: supersaw_lead

7 saw oscillators detuned about 22 cents; lowpass filter at 5000 hz, q 0.8, envelope amount 0.4; amp attack 10 ms, decay 150 ms, sustain 0.8, release 300 ms; delay 8n. at 30% feedback, 30% wet; reverb 3 s, 20% wet.

## PAD

trancegen preset: warm_pad

5 saw oscillators detuned about 18 cents; lowpass filter at 1400 hz, q 0.7, envelope amount 0.3; amp attack 600 ms, decay 600 ms, sustain 0.8, release 900 ms; reverb 4.5 s, 35% wet.

## BASS

trancegen preset: offbeat_bass

1 saw oscillator, sub at 0.8; lowpass filter at 700 hz, q 1.2, envelope amount 1.2; amp attack 2 ms, decay 120 ms, sustain 0.5, release 40 ms.
